image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a small turtle resting on a textured green surface (likely artificial turf or moss). The turtle has a dark brown, high-domed carapace with distinct longitudinal ridges (keels). Its head is extended, showing greyish skin with yellow striping on the neck. One front limb is visible, appearing short and clawed. The plastron edge is visible, showing a lighter, yellowish-orange color.

The tail is completely occluded by the carapace and the angle of the turtle's body.
